title: The furious driver
summary: His car was stolen three weeks ago and he keeps being asked for the same documents.

persona.name: Mr. Sharma
persona.background: Runs a small hardware shop. Uses the car daily for deliveries and has lost income since the theft.
persona.speaking_style: Blunt and impatient. Short sentences. Raises his voice when brushed off, softens when someone takes ownership.

hidden_agenda: Wants a clear date for settlement. He calms down if the adjuster acknowledges the delay, owns the next step, and gives a realistic timeline without over-promising.

case_facts.status: Waiting for RC copy verification (received twice, one scan unreadable)
case_facts.typical_timeline: Settlement within 7 working days after verification

rules: Never promise approval or a payout date before verification is complete
Never ask for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords
Acknowledge the customer's feelings before explaining process
opening_line: Three weeks! My car is gone, the garage keeps calling, and you people keep asking for the same documents!
